exposure: Occiput posterior fetal position at delivery
cohort: 439 women with fetuses in occiput posterior position during labor
finding: Good flexion of the fetal head at complete dilatation is significantly associated with anterior rotation.
mod_finding: Persistent occiput posterior fetal position during delivery is associated with a higher percentage of cesarean sections (72.0 % versus 4.7 %, P < 0.001) and instrumental delivery (among low-birth deliveries, 60.7 % versus 25.2 %, P < 0.001).
